what: An R Package To Assist In Calculating Minor Political Parties' I-Scores
title: An R Package To Assist In Calculating Minor Political Parties' I-Scores
text: IScorePackage R package designed allow researchers easily calculate minor political parties’ -Scores, quantitative measure extent minor party influences major parties political environment. -Scores composed two components, capture different dimensions minor-party influence: Ie-Score (issue-emphasis score): Measures change emphasis major parties place minor party’s core issue areas. Ie-Scores measured increase decrease (points) percentage average major-party platform devoted minor party’s average core issue area. interpreted Ie-Score rescales measure percentage change. Ip-Score (issue-position score): Measures change position major parties take minor party’s core issue areas. Ip-Scores measured number standard deviations shifted toward minor party average major party minor party’s average core issue area. Note: measures, term “average major party minor party’s average core issue area” refers weighted average incorporates three layers weighting: importance minor party assigns issue area, weight researcher assigns major party, geometric weighting emphasizes best change (recognize persuading one major party likely incentivize others move away positions still rewarding minor party capable influencing multiple major parties simultaneously). measures developed Theodore Gercken Beyond Ballot Box: Toward Comprehensive Measure Minor Party Success.

However, documents must language Wordfish algorithm assumes single distribution words across documents. may use platforms published 1945 languages supported ManifestoBERTA model.

Ie-Scores reflect changes emphasis major parties place minor party’s core issues (Ie-Scores measure change percentage points; interpreted Ie-Scores measure change percent), Ip-Scores track shifts position major parties issues.
